entries.heading: TECHNICAL CORRECTION TO DEADLINE FOR TRANSITION TO DEFENSE READINESS REPORTING SYSTEM STRATEGIC
entries.text:
SEC. 362. TECHNICAL CORRECTION TO DEADLINE FOR TRANSITION TO 
                        DEFENSE READINESS REPORTING SYSTEM 
                        STRATEGIC.

    Section 358(c) of the John S. McCain National Defense Authorization 
Act for Fiscal Year 2019 (Public Law 115-232) is amended by striking ``October 1, 2019'' and inserting 
``October 1, 2020''.
